Product Features

  • Room adaptability: 140 x 40 x 84 cm in size, suitable for living rooms, hallways and offices. Three cabinet doors + multi-layer design can create a double effect of "storage + atmosphere" in narrow spaces.
  • Glass door ingenuity: 2 tempered glass doors, transparent and exquisite, with LED light strips controlled by remote control, one-touch lighting that gives atmosphere to the room and immediately gives the collections and ornaments "their debut in the middle position".
  • High Gloss Design: The front cabinet door is made of white high gloss material with high quality texture. The three sides are hollowed out + LED light strips break the monotony and maximize the sense of design. It is a real eye-catcher in the living room or office.
  • Multi-layer storage: 3-layer structure + adjustable dividers (two layers inside), books, sundries and office supplies can be stored in categories. Whether it's a side cabinet in the living room, a storage cabinet in the hallway or a filing cabinet in the office, each layer has its own function and storage is super flexible.
  • Create atmosphere: The light strip can be controlled by remote control and switched on at any time. The light shines through the cavity and glass door, giving the room a warm and fashionable vibe that is very stylish when chatting or working.
  • Practical material: The cabinet is made of chipboard, is sturdy and durable, and can support a weight of 50kg. It is stable and can be used in various scenarios.
  • Adaptable to multiple scenarios: storing sundries and decorations in the living room, storing cleaning utensils in the hallway, and collecting documents in the office. A cabinet can meet several space requirements and is practical and versatile.
  • Extra points for details: Adjustable dividers can accommodate items of different heights, high-gloss cabinet doors are easy to clean, and the hollow design cleverly hides streaks of light. Every detail is designed to enhance the structure of the space.
  • Functional integration: By integrating storage, atmosphere and presentation in one, it is not only a "beauty" of the space (glass door + high light + light strip), but also a "maker" of storage (layered + adjustable). A cabinet meets several requirements and makes your home and office more colorful!

Describe

This living room sideboard measures 140 x 40 x 84 cm and has three doors. Two of the doors are transparent and made of tempered glass. The LED light strips are controlled by remote control and create an atmospheric atmosphere in the living room. The white part of the front door is high-gloss. The three sides feature a hollowed-out design that complements the LED light strips for a stylish design. The cabinet is divided into two levels by adjustable partitions. The upper level offers a large storage area with a weight of approx. 50 kg. Made of white chipboard, it is suitable for living rooms, hallways and offices.
